reports.title: Transitional Constitution of the Republic of South Sudan, 2011
reports.description: South Sudan's Transitional Constitution. Directly verified via pdftotext extraction of the FAOLEX-hosted official text. Article 168(5),(7),(8) (Guiding Principles): "The sharing and allocation of resources and national wealth shall be based on the premise that all states, localities and communities are entitled to equitable development without discrimination... The National Government shall fulfill its obligations to provide financial transfers to all levels of government, and shall... apportion revenue equitably among the states and local governments... Revenue sharing shall reflect a commitment to devolution of powers and decentralisation of decision-making." Article 176(1) and 177(f) set a specific quantified formula: "at least two percent of net oil and other mineral revenues for each producing state." Article 178(1) establishes the National Revenue Fund ("All revenue collected for or by the National Government shall be pooled in a National Revenue Fund administered by the Ministry of Finance and Economic Planning"), and Article 179(1) establishes the National Fiscal and Financial Allocation and Monitoring Commission ("an independent commission... to ensure transparency and fairness in regard to the allocation of funds collected at the level of the National Government to the states and local governments"). CORRECTION: there is no "National Revenue Authority" named anywhere in this Constitution — the relevant bodies are the National Revenue Fund (a pooled account) and the Fiscal and Financial Allocation and Monitoring Commission (an oversight body), not a revenue-collection authority. South Sudan's internal state structure has been highly unstable (10 states originally, expanded to 32 in 2015, reverted toward 10 states + 3 administrative areas under the 2018 Revitalized Peace Agreement) — the 2018 Agreement's own fiscal-federalism text was not independently located this round (only secondary commentary), flagged for a future session.
